basic_info.description: Live at the fabulous LUMINA - San Francisco's premier high rise condominium in South Beach just steps from the waterfront. Residence 2G is a generous 1 bedroom + Den floor plan with ~1013sf. of living space, two full bathrooms and ample storage. The residence features a chef's kitchen with top of the line finishes, included Gaggenau appliances, SieMatic kitchen cabinets, Premium Caesarstone quartz countertops, and European porcelain bathroom flooring and shower tiles. This residence includes an additonal storage unit purchased separately by the Seller. The pristine, pride of ownership, residence was purchased new from the developer and has had only one owner. Amoung the incomparable amenities offered at LUMINA are the state-of the-art Jay Wright designed fitness center, swimming pool, hot tub, sauna, rock climbing wall, children's playroom, movie theater, indoor/outdoor club lounge, game room, private dining room, business center, boardroom, rooftop with BBQ area, music room, pet grooming station, concierge services, 24/7 lobby attendant, valet parking and many others. Parking fee is included in the HOA dues. Live in the East Cut, San Francisco's newest and most vibrant neighborhood.
